items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Willie told them, he said, “No, I’m going to stay over here with my brothers.” He was fair enough to be more caucasian than anybody up there. ... they found out he played with Jimmie Lunceford, Harry James, Charlie Spivak

ctx.x: I understand that Willie Smith was there.

Willie Smith was the lead alto player. We got him out of boot camp and brought him over there. When we got him over there and they found out who they had – they didn’t know what – he was just another dude that was in the Navy. When we got him over there, they found out he played with Jimmie Lunceford, Harry James, Charlie Spivak, [ ? ? ].
